CustomField.inlineHelpText:
URL of the webpage you want this item to redirect to on being clicked. This can be any external URL(e.g. google.com) or a relative URL to a specific community page(e.g. /contactsupport). The relative URL must begin with a / symbol.
You may keep it blank if you plan to have sub-menu items under this record.
Use only / if you want to redirect to the home page.
CustomField.label: URL
